messages:
maria: quick sync — spotted three small problems in the SDK snippets page: TS uses old "cursor" name, Go retry has no jitter, and py streaming example doesn't show cancellation.

lee: thanks, can take TS. i'll add both async iterator and callback forms and include AbortController abort example. will update the pagination link to the new spec.

own: i'll handle Go. plan to add context cancellation + jittered backoff and a tiny test that asserts backoff < 600ms in CI. example: sleep = 100ms * (1<<i) + rand(0,50)ms.

maria: i pushed a small python PR that adds cancel + resume_token snippet and a Troubleshooting note about long prefix caches. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999

docs-bot: (docs-bot) PR 4999: link-check failed -> replaced internal link; lint warnings: one line over 120 chars in code block.

sam: split PRs for fast review please (one per language + one migration note). makes it easier to land quickly.

own: opened Go PR #5001, added test and README for snippets folder. tagging @sam for jitter check.

lee: opened TS PR #5000, included AbortController and updated pagination link. added compatibility blurb: "v0.9 uses cursor, v1.0+ uses resume_token". tagging @maria for a quick doc pass.

maria: will review TS and Go, will open migration PR with side-by-side sandbox after those merge. include a short compatibility table and an FAQ about timeouts vs retries.

docs-bot: (docs-bot) CI green for #5000, #5001.

sam: quick nit — keep the migration doc high-level; avoid deep internals of KV cache. link to infra doc instead.

own: addressed sam's nit, tightened jitter range to keep test flakiness low. updated PR.

lee: merged #5000 after addressing wording.

maria: merged #4999 earlier. building migration PR now with sandbox and cross-links to 4999/5000/5001.

docs-bot: (docs-bot) #5002 (migration + sandbox) opened by maria. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5002

sam: quick editorial pass done, added changelog cross-ref. LGTM — feel free to merge.

maria: merged #5002. all snippets updated and migration note live. closing thread. :tada:
